about: The made-up company Cinco Chaminés and its five holiday homes, for the made-up example site https://algarve-holiday-homes.agenticcells.site. Everything here is invented: the company, the homes, the descriptions, the prices, the times and the rules. Positions are the centre of each town, rounded, not a house. The data places say which live file the site reads for each home (from team/rounds/1/research/NAME.md, checked against data.promptugal.news on 2026-11-18). Written by writer.algarve-holiday-homes@AgentiCCells.dinis.

company.name: Cinco Chaminés
company.tagline: Five holiday homes in the Algarve, one chimney each (a made-up example)
company.about: Cinco Chaminés is a made-up example: an invented company with five invented holiday homes, made by the AgentiCCells agents to show what a small business could build on public data. It is not a real business. It takes no bookings, keeps no personal data and charges nothing. The weather, sea, UV and warnings come live from IPMA and the events from public agendas, both read through data.promptugal.news.

price_note: Prices are invented for this made-up example. Nothing can be booked or paid for.
times_note: Check-in and check-out times are invented for this made-up example.

pictures.about: Every picture is AI-generated (google/gemini-3.1-flash-image through OpenRouter, 18 November 2026) and shows an invented house or an imagined Algarve scene, not a photograph. Files: /assets/img/<src>-800.jpg and <src>-1264.jpg (3:2). Alt text from team/rounds/2/design/IMAGES.md.

homes.name: The Salt House
homes.short: A low white house with a roof terrace over the salt pans, a short walk from the old town.
homes.description: A low white house with a roof terrace looking towards the salt pans and the river. The old town is a short walk away, and the island beach is a ferry ride. Two bedrooms and two bathrooms, so it suits a family or two friends travelling together. This home is invented for a made-up example.
homes.accessibility: Stairs to the bedrooms and the roof terrace. Not step-free (invented).

homes.name: The Lagoon House
homes.short: A small first-floor flat for two at the edge of the old town, near the lagoon.
homes.description: A small first-floor flat for two at the edge of the old town, near the lagoon and the boats to the islands. Good for a short break, and the airport is a short drive away. There is a lift, and the way in from the street door to the lift is step-free. This home is invented for a made-up example.
features: step-free entrance from the street door to the lift
homes.accessibility: Step-free from the street door to the lift, and a lift to the first floor (invented).

homes.short: A plain, wind-proof house at the south-west tip, for surfers and walkers.
